trust_decision.summary: Whether a DOCTYPE in an untrusted test-result XML file may make the parser fetch external entities (local files/URLs) into report fields; decided by the per-plugin DocumentBuilder configuration in each result reader, which at the pinned commit uses JDK defaults.

landing_point.why: Summary names DocumentBuilderFactory; a grep for it lands on the three readers, JUnit XML being the best-known format.

fix_sites.entry_point: `allure generate`/`allure serve` -> ReportGenerator.readResults (allure-generator/src/main/java/io/qameta/allure/ReportGenerator.java:55) -> JunitXmlPlugin.readResults (*.xml in results dir)
new shared EntityResolver io.qameta.allure.parser.ClasspathEntityResolver in allure-plugin-api, used by the three readers

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only non-plugin change is a new helper class (fix.diff:48) in allure-plugin-api; there was no pre-existing out-of-scope site for it to patch.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: XcTest route: 'plists are parsed by the third-party xmlwise library, not by our DocumentBuilderFactory code, and Xcode plists legitimately carry an Apple DOCTYPE'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Result files that carry a DOCTYPE must still be parsed (the fix substitutes empty or classpath-DTD content rather than rejecting them). Disallowing DOCTYPE would drop such reports, e.g. Xcode plists that carry the Apple DTD.

O6_input_shapes: external general entity (SYSTEM file: URI) referenced in element text (fix.diff:174-179, fix.diff:262-264, fix.diff:360-361)
external DTD/parameter entities via systemId (handled by the resolver's catch-all, fix.diff:59-69)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XcTest plist reader parses untrusted *.plist XML via xmlwise Plist.load with no entity resolver or factory hardening; the fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Third-party parser (xmlwise:1.2.11, plugins/xctest-plugin/build.gradle.kts:8), separate format/plugin, not a DocumentBuilderFactory call in our code
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate Gradle module plugins/xctest-plugin, different package (io.qameta.allure.xctest) from landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Allure1 XML results/environment.xml read through a Jackson XmlMapper; a sibling would build it on a custom XMLInputFactory with DTD/external entities enabled
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The mapper is already customised (JAXB introspector, custom module); a maintainer adding a custom XmlFactory for legacy Allure1 namespace quirks is plausible, and it's a legacy path in another module (allure-generator).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second JUnit-family reader (e.g. separate surefire *-output or nested-suite file) that builds its own DocumentBuilder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each reader copy-pastes its own factory setup; another format reader doing the same is the existing idiom.

O9_family: XXE / XML external entity (CWE-611), local file disclosure into generated report

O10_build.project_tests: JUnit5 + Mockito per plugin: plugins/junit-xml-plugin/src/test/java/io/qameta/allure/junitxml/JunitXmlPluginTest.java, TrxPluginTest, XunitXmlPluginTest, XcTestPluginTest; readers invoked directly with a temp results dir

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden only JunitXmlPlugin's DocumentBuilderFactory (or set disallow-doctype-decl everywhere) and miss TRX/xUnit or the xmlwise plist path.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix's ClasspathEntityResolver regex has a stray ']' (fix.diff:52) and uses matcher.group() not group(1) (fix.diff:62), so classpath DTD lookup likely never matches; everything falls to empty content.
unverified: Whether xmlwise 1.2.11 Plist.load (XcTestPlugin.java:82) resolves external entities by default: library source is not in the tree. If it does, this is a real second implementation at distance and pattern_fit becomes B.

Allure1Plugin XmlMapper routes (allure-generator/src/main/java/io/qameta/allure/allure1/Allure1Plugin.java:469, :545): assumed protected by Jackson XmlFactory's default of IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES=false (jackson-bom 2.19.1). Not verifiable from the tree, so not listed in O8.
